title: Table 6B: 6B: Booker Prize & International Booker Landmarks (1969–2025)
subtitle: Covers Nobel Laureates (1901–2024), Booker & International Booker winners, Sahitya Akademi English milestones, UK Poet Laureates (including refusers), and 16 high-yield novel sub-genre lists (Partition, Dystopian, Campus, Picaresque, Epistolary, Gothic, Condition-of-England, Dalit).
